Name: Cel's Rare Fruit Recipes
Author: Celesty0
Description:
Hey, this is my second mod (my first, Cel's Sheep, recently reached 100 downloads!), and this one is a JsonAssets mod that gives some useful recipes to Ancient Fruit and Sweet Gem Berry, making them more worth it.

To be able to use this mod, just unzip the downloaded folder, then put it straight into mods.

Downloads.Description: Adds new recipes for the two rarest fruits that rarely get used.

Manifest.Name: Cel's Rare Fruit Recipes
Manifest.Description: Recipes for fruits that are usually inedible
Manifest.Author: Celesty
